value.note: Most results are distortion bounds. There are also strategyproofness results (SB), synthetic simulations (SI) and Jester real-data experiments (EM).

C1.reason: No main result is axiomatic: the lower bounds are distortion bounds, and the strategyproofness results are already covered by SB, so AX does not apply.

value.note: Outside the strategyproofness definition, mechanisms are applied directly to δ(I), which would be IDU. The strategyproofness text says reports may differ from held valuations v_i, so DIST is coded.

C2.4.reason: The paper says an agent may report information different from its held valuations, which are still used for evaluation; this meets the DIST condition.
